description: This PHP source file defines a custom ViewDetail class for the Campaigns module in SuiteCRM. It overrides the default detail view behavior to customize the display of campaign details, handles subpanel display logic, manages campaign-specific button states, and integrates campaign tracking functionality.

classes.name: CampaignsViewDetail
classes.description: Custom view class for rendering detailed campaign information with specific UI and behavior modifications.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the view, disables subpanel display by default.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Modifies module strings based on campaign type, preparing display before rendering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles setting up the display environment, managing subpanels, buttons, currency info, and executing subpanel filtering logic.
